description: Add something only the Developer can try by hand to a claimed Goal, such as 'OpenCode may ask permission to read an attached file: allow it and check the reply'. Put it here instead of in your chat summary: the Developer sees the Goal's hand-test list on the dashboard and marks each one there as works, doesn't work (with a note) or won't test. A failure adds a Task to the Goal by itself; get_status shows what is still open and the new marks. complete_goal with tests unmarked leaves the Goal waiting on them, and it finishes when the last is marked. With id: reword it, change which Task it is about, or remove it with an empty text (for one that turned out not to need testing); its mark stays, and only the Developer marks tests.

goal.description: The claimed Goal's ID, such as 'ship-oauth-login'. Needed only when this Session holds several Goals.

id.description: A hand test's ID, such as 'h2', to change it; leave out to add one.

task.description: The ID of the Task it is about, such as 't3'; with id, an empty string removes the link.

text.description: What to try and what to look for, in one or two short plain sentences; with id, empty removes it.

name: save_hand_test
title: Save hand test
